serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Finally home…
It's not like I have problems with going outside. It's just that nothing beats this sense of security of your own flat. 
It's time for some coff…{{wi}}ee.
…
My coffee machine made me a fresh cup again... Someone must have broken into my wifi and is playing pranks on me…
How does he get the right timing though?
Am I being… {{wi}}observed?
A-anyway! I need to change my wifi password as fast as possible! If this guy is some hacker he can brick my computer or worse!
